name: Police Accountability
description: Changes to police oversight, COPA powers, and department policies.
queries: Civilian Office of Police Accountability powers
summary: The most contested item was O2025-0020004, which amended Municipal Code Section 2-78-120 to expand COPA's powers to investigate complaints against CPD members alleging Welcoming City Ordinance violations. At the 2026-01-27 joint committee hearing, COPA testified it lacked jurisdiction over such complaints, had received roughly 40 ICE-related complaints (28 potentially involving Welcoming City violations), and was prepared to begin investigations immediately upon passage [2][4][12]. A motion to defer and publish was made at the 2026-02-18 City Council meeting [3], but the ordinance passed 50 Yea / 0 Nay on 2026-03-18 [7]. Separately, SO2025-0015584, amending Section 2-78-120 (e-5) and adding Section 2-84-530 restricting CPD members, passed 28 Yea / 21 Nay on 2026-05-20 after being on the Committee on Workforce Development agenda 2026-04-13. The City Council also approved Lakenya White as COPA Chief Administrator 50 Yea / 0 Nay on 2026-03-18 (A2026-0023341). Oversight activity continued: the Inspector General reported 15 recommendations to reopen COPA investigations in 2024, of which COPA accepted 10 and declined 5 [5], and declined to reopen an FTO use-of-force case despite OIG's recommendation [6]. COPA's FY2027 proposed budget (~$17 million, a 7.58% increase, with a 22.67% vacancy rate as of 2026-10-21) was presented at the 2026-11-05 budget hearing [1], and remains subject to approval. Routine appropriation amendments for CPD within Fund No. 925 (O2026-0025214, O2026-0026183, O2026-0026839) all passed with 49-50 Yea and 0 Nay between 2026-05-20 and 2026-07-15.
one_line: Council expanded COPA's Welcoming City investigative powers (50-0), passed CPD restrictions (28-21), approved new COPA chief; FY2027 budget pending.
